title: Operation “Sponsored Discontent”: Influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned likely China-origin accounts using AI to generate English social posts and Spanish-language articles.
body: OpenAI banned likely China-origin accounts using AI to generate English social posts and Spanish-language articles.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布威胁情报，指出封禁了一批可能源自中国的账户，这些账户利用大模型批量生成英文社交媒体帖子和西班牙语文章，参与代号为“Sponsored Discontent”的网络影响力活动。此举反映了AI大模型厂商在打击跨国虚假宣传方面的持续动作。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI报告了代号“Sponsored Discontent”的中国关联虚假信息生成活动，展示了AI滥用治理的新动态。
